name: Google App Engine
line: Build and run apps on Google's managed application platform.

free.text: Standard: 28 F1/9 B1 hours + 1GiB egress/day; Flexible has no free compute

cells.regions: US, Europe, Asia and other GCP regions

work.math: Delivery is $7.46–$11.06 a month (even spread, or all 100 GB in one day). Standard build, storage and other usage are not priced.
Assuming 1 vCPU, 2 GiB of memory and 10 GiB of disk, the $67.70 subtotal includes one free IPv4 hour per GiB. The actual VM size, other charges and rollout costs vary.
The small app API's $67.70 example + $54.62 Cloud SQL base + $0.00011726 for each backup GiB-hour, plus database network and other charges. The exact total is unknown.
